# `catchIfTagToCatchTag`

Suggests Effect.catchTag instead of Effect.catchIf with a direct _tag equality predicate

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377131` |
| Language Service name | `catchIfTagToCatchTag` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/catch-if-tag-to-catch-tag` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Data, Effect } from "effect"

class NotFound extends Data.TaggedError("NotFound")<{}> {}
class Timeout extends Data.TaggedError("Timeout")<{}> {}

declare const program: Effect.Effect<string, NotFound | Timeout>

export const recovered = program.pipe(
  Effect.catchIf(
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(catch-if-tag-to-catch-tag): Effect.catchTag expresses tagged error recovery more directly than Effect.catchIf with a `_tag` equality predicate.
*/
    (error) => error._tag === "NotFound",
    () => Effect.succeed("guest")
  )
)
```
